page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c9i.12xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual server instance deployed on the KVM hypervisor. It runs on the x86_64 architecture and is driven by an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor operating at 3.2 GHz. The resource layout contains 48 dedicated vCPUs paired with 96.0 GB of system memory, producing a 1:2 memory-to-vCPU ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU. Hardware accelerators such as GPUs are not present on this machine.

Storage and network characteristics reflect a decoupled architecture. The instance includes no integrated local storage, requiring network-attached block storage for operating system images and persistent state. Network performance is provisioned with a 25 Gbps baseline bandwidth, though the instance does not bundle complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures predictable core performance free from virtualization oversubscription.

Resource allocation on this profile emphasizes processing power over high memory capacity or direct disk IOPS. The 2.0 GB per core ratio delivers a cost-efficient hardware footprint for tasks where CPU processing limits overall throughput. Tradeoffs include reliance on external block devices for all I/O requirements. This instance fits CPU-bound tasks such as distributed batch processing, code compilation, CI/CD pipeline workers, and high-throughput application serving.
